jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Since then, we've built the world's largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar — tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Check our open-source projects here.

•
•

•

The Design Team

Proton's Design team shapes the visual and interaction layer across Mail, Drive, VPN, Pass, and Calendar — products used by millions of people, many of whom rely on them in high-stakes moments. We work at the intersection of security and simplicity: our products must inspire trust without feeling intimidating, and feel refined without sacrificing clarity. Designers are embedded within engineering teams and involved from the very beginning — problem framing, planning, implementation, and quality assurance — not brought in at the mockup stage. The team is organized as a guild: high autonomy, shared standards, and real influence over how design is practiced across Proton.

We hold a high craft bar. Typography, layout, spacing, color, iconography, motion — the details most companies treat as polish, we treat as the product. If your best work is the work itself — pixels you're proud to sign — you'll be in good company here.

•
•

•

What You'll Do

•
  • Own the visual and interaction quality of one or more Proton products — from early concepts through production, until what ships matches the design intent
  • Design interfaces that make sophisticated privacy and security features feel intuitive and trustworthy — without oversimplifying what's underneath
  • Craft visual systems — typography, hierarchy, spacing, color, iconography — that scale across millions of users
  • Design motion, transitions, and micro-interactions that add meaning, not decoration
  • Create icons, illustrations, and visual assets that strengthen Proton's visual language and stay consistent across products

•

  • Experience building and evolving design systems — not just consuming them — and understanding how consistency and flexibility work together
  • Experience designing motion and micro-interactions as integral parts of production UI, not afterthoughts
  • Highly proficient in Figma — moving fluidly from exploration to high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes
  • Ownership beyond your immediate work — you notice quality issues and inconsistencies, and you act on them
•

Nice to Have

•

  • Portfolio showcasing illustration, iconography, or visual identity work
  • Familiarity with front-end implementation and the practical constraints of HTML and CSS

•

What We Offer

  • Work that Matters: Millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments.
  • A Great Team: Diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit, with people from MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, ETH, and more.

Designers are embedded within engineering teams and involved from the very beginning — problem framing, planning, implementation, and quality assurance — not brought in at the mockup stage. The team is organized as a guild: high autonomy, shared standards, and real influence over how design is practiced across Proton.

Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 700+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

Purpose of the role:

Proton is growing fast as more people worldwide seek greater control over their online privacy. To support that growth, we're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a team on one of our upcoming products.

You'll join the engineering leadership team, helping turn technical strategy into execution and contributing to a more privacy centric internet. We're looking for an Engineering Manager with a strong mobile focus. That means a track record of building and scaling customer facing mobile applications, in B2C or B2B, for millions of users on iOS and/or Android.

Beyond technical depth, our Engineering Managers bring strong people management skills, clear communication, a business mindset, and genuine empathy for customers.

• Requirements:

  • Experience leading and growing engineering teams of 10+ engineers in a fast-paced product environment.
  • Proven success managing fully remote and/or distributed engineering teams, with strong operational and communication practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner closely with Product and Design on strategy, roadmap planning, prioritization, and execution. Comfortable challenging assumptions, driving alignment, and translating ambiguity into high-quality product delivery.
  • Strong technical foundation in mobile engineering, with deep expertise in Swift, Kotlin, and/or Rust.
  • Hands on technical leader with experience in mobile architecture, debugging, release management, app performance, and engineering trade offs.
  • Experience building and scaling consumer mobile products with 1M+ monthly active users (MAU).
  • A track record of delivering measurable impact, with clear examples of improving metrics such as user growth, retention, release cadence, product quality, reliability, engineering productivity, or team effectiveness.
  • Experience operating in a high-velocity mobile development environment, with a strong focus on release predictability, engineering excellence, app quality, and disciplined execution.
  • Proton is an office-first company. We expect you to spend most of your time in the office, and while we do offer some flexibility to work from home, we believe in-person collaboration helps us build the best products.

What we are looking for:

  • Direct exposure to features such as presence, channels, notifications, sync, low-latency messaging, or engagement loops.
  • Track record improving release cadence, crash rate, ANR rate, app-store review quality, or release confidence.
  • Experience hiring and developing engineering teams.
  • Experience spanning both webapp/desktop and mobile (iOS and Android teams), or client plus adjacent backend ownership.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance speed, quality, and high engineering standard in fast paced environment.

Bonus points for:

  • Rust experience.
  • Experience in collaboration, social or other real-time communication products.
  • Background in privacy-first, security-focused, or mission-driven products.
  • Experience with end-to-end encryption, secure communications.
  • Experience in community scale or multi device products where reliability and sync are critical.
  • Experience building high impact open source solutions.
  • Experience in applying AI in sustainable manner in the development and test process.

What We Offer

  • Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
  • Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
  • Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
  • Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
  • Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
  • Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.

Gehen Sie Proton bei und bauen Sie ein besseres Internet auf, in dem Privatsphäre standardmäßig ist

Proton wurde 2014 von Wissenschaftlern des CERN mit einer einfachen Wahrheit gegründet: Privatsphäre ist ein grundlegendes Menschenrecht. Seitdem haben wir den weltweit größten verschlüsselten E-Mail-Dienst (Proton Mail) aufgebaut und in Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass und Proton Kalender erweitert - Tools, die von Millionen weltweit zum Schutz ihrer Freiheit, zur Bekämpfung der Zensur und zur Sicherheit ihrer Daten verwendet werden. In manchen Situationen hat Proton buchstäblich geholfen, Leben zu retten!

Wir sind profitabel, unabhängig (keine VC-Kontrolle) und stellen selektiv von den Top ~ 1% der Bewerber ein. Unsere über 700 Teammitglieder in über 50 Ländern stammen aus führenden Organisationen und Elite-akademischen Hintergründen. Wir bewegen uns schnell, halten die Hierarchie hell und priorisieren den Einfluss auf die Optik. Wenn Sie mit außergewöhnlich hochkarätigen Menschen sinnvolle Arbeit leisten möchten, ist es dies. Begleiten Sie uns und machen Sie Arbeit, auf die Sie wirklich stolz sein können. Schauen Sie sich unsere Open-Source-Projekte an hier!

Zweck der Rolle:

Proton wächst schnell, da mehr menschen weltweit eine größere kontrolle über ihre online-privatsphäre suchen. Um dieses Wachstum zu unterstützen, stellen wir einen Senior Engineering Manager ein, der ein Team für eines unserer kommenden Produkte leitet.

Sie werden dem Engineering-Führungsteam beitreten und dabei helfen, die technische Strategie in die Ausführung zu verwandeln und zu einem datenschutzorientierteren Internet beizutragen. Wir suchen einen Engineering Manager mit einem starken mobilen Fokus. Dies bedeutet eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erstellung und Skalierung von mobilen Anwendungen für Kunden in B2C oder B2B für Millionen von Benutzern auf iOS und / oder Android.

Über die technische Tiefe hinaus bringen unsere Engineering Manager starke Mitarbeitermanagementfähigkeiten, klare Kommunikation, eine unternehmerische Denkweise und echte Empathie für Kunden mit.

• Anforderungen:

  • Erleben Sie führende und wachsende Engineering-Teams von über 10 Ingenieuren in einer schnelllebigen Produktumgebung.
  • Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Verwaltung vollständig entfernter und/oder verteilter Engineering-Teams mit starken Betriebs- und Kommunikationspraktiken.
  • Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, eng mit Produkt und Design in Bezug auf Strategie, Roadmapplanung, Priorisierung und Ausführung zusammenzuarbeiten. Komfortable herausfordernde Annahmen, die Ausrichtung vorantreiben und Mehrdeutigkeiten in eine qualitativ hochwertige Produktlieferung umsetzen.
  • Starkes technisches Fundament im Mobile Engineering, mit fundierter Expertise in Swift, Kotlin und/oder Rust.
  • Hands on Technical Leader mit Erfahrung in der mobilen Architektur, Debugging, Release-Management, App-Performance und Engineering Trade-Offs.
  • Erleben Sie das Erstellen und Skalieren von mobilen Consumer-Produkten mit monatlich 1M+ aktiven Nutzern (MAU).
  • Eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung messbarer Auswirkungen mit klaren Beispielen für die Verbesserung von Metriken wie Benutzerwachstum, Retention, Release-Kadenz, Produktqualität, Zuverlässigkeit, Engineering-Produktivität oder Teameffektivität.
  • Erfahrung in einer mobilen Entwicklungsumgebung mit hoher Geschwindigkeit, mit einem starken Fokus auf Vorhersagbarkeit der Veröffentlichung, technischer Exzellenz, App-Qualität und disziplinierter Ausführung.

Was wir suchen:

  • Direkte Exposition gegenüber Funktionen wie Präsenz, Kanäle, Benachrichtigungen, Synchronisierung, Nachrichten mit niedriger Latenz oder Engagement-Loops.
  • Track Record verbessert Release-Kadenz, Crash-Rate, ANR-Rate, App-Store-Review-Qualität oder Release-Vertrauen.
  • Erfahrung bei der Einstellung und Entwicklung von Ingenieurteams.
  • Erfahrung, die sowohl Webapp/Desktop als auch Mobile (iOS- und Android-Teams) oder Client plus angrenzender Backend-Besitz umfasst.
  • Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Geschwindigkeit, Qualität und hohen technischen Standard in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung auszugleichen.

Bonuspunkte für:

  • Rusterfahrung.
  • Erfahrung in Zusammenarbeit, sozialen oder anderen Echtzeit-Kommunikationsprodukten.
  • Hintergrund in Privacy-First-, Security-fokussierten oder Mission-driven-Produkten.
  • Erfahrung mit Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung, sichere Kommunikation.
  • Erfahrung in Community-Skala oder Multi-Geräte-Produkten, bei denen Zuverlässigkeit und Synchronisierung entscheidend sind.
  • Erleben Sie den Aufbau wirkungsvoller Open-Source-Lösungen.
  • Erfahrung im nachhaltigen Einsatz von KI im Entwicklungs- und Testprozess.

Was wir anbieten

  • Office First: Die Zusammenarbeit ist persönlich einfacher und effektiver, weshalb wir Büros in Genf, Zürich, Prag, Barcelona, Paris, London, Vilnius, Skopje und Taipeh haben. Sie können auch bis zu 30% der Zeit von zu Hause aus arbeiten und während unserer drei Kerntage im Büro eine großartige Gesellschaft genießen. Abhängig von der Rolle können auch vollständig entfernte Positionen verfügbar sein.
  • Technologie: Wir bieten alle Geräte und Software, die Sie benötigen, um Ihre Rolle zu übertreffen, und stellen sicher, dass Sie über die besten Werkzeuge verfügen, um Ihre Ziele zu erreichen.

Au-delà de la profondeur technique, nos gestionnaires d'ingénierie apportent de solides compétences en gestion des personnes, une communication claire, un état d'esprit d'entreprise et une véritable empathie pour les clients.

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. We are looking for a Business Development Manager focused on building strategic partnerships and generating high-quality pipeline for Proton’s B2B business. This is a key role focused on identifying and unlocking new business opportunities — not closing deals.

You will work on developing relationships with key organisations, partners, and networks — particularly within Switzerland — to position Proton within strategic ecosystems and create long-term pipeline opportunities.

This role requires a strong talent to network, a “hunter” mindset for opportunity creation, and the ability to navigate complex organisations to open doors for commercial engagement.

Pipeline Creation & Strategic Opportunity Development

- Identify and develop new strategic opportunities across target segments

- Build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities for the sales team

- Focus on long-term opportunity creation rather than short-term deal closing

Strategic Partnerships

- Identify, engage, and develop partnerships with corporates, industry bodies, service providers, ecosystem partners (including co-selling opportunities)

Market Development (Switzerland Focus)

- Leverage your existing network within Swiss corporates and organisations

- Expand Proton’s presence within local business ecosystems

- Identify high-value entry points into target companies

Relationship Building

- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders (IT, security, leadership)

- Act as a trusted advisor and entry point into organisations

- Navigate complex organisational structures to identify opportunities

Sales Opportunity Discovery and Closing

- Identify and qualify opportunities

- Provide clear context on use case, stakeholders, potential deal scope

-Negotiate and close deals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Sales leadership to align on target segments

- Provide feedback on market opportunities and ICP evolution

- Share insights from partnerships and market interactions

Experience

- 3–7 years in Business Development, Partnerships, or Strategic Sales roles

- Experience in B2B SaaS or technology environments

- Proven track record in building partnerships and generating pipeline

Network

- Strong existing network within Swiss companies and/or business ecosystem (highly preferred)

- Appetite to develop and grow a network of Swiss and DACH companies

Skills

- Strong relationship-building and networking capabilities

- Ability to identify and develop strategic opportunities

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

- Comfortable operating without a structured playbook

Languages

- Fluent in English (required)

- Business-level proficiency in BOTH French and German (required)

Mindset

- Hunter mindset focused on opportunity creation

- Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts

- Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable operating in ambiguity

- Long-term relationship builder

- Proton is an office-first company. We expect you to spend most of your time in the office, and while we do offer some flexibility to work from home, we believe in-person collaboration helps us build the best products.

  • Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
  • Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
  • Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
  • Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.

LinkedIn ,Reddit ,X, YouTube

Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

At Proton, we believe that privacy is a fundamental human right and the cornerstone of democracy. Since our inception in 2014, founded by a team of scientists from CERN, we have dedicated ourselves to providing free and open-source technology to millions worldwide, ensuring access to privacy, security, and freedom online.

Our journey began with Proton Mail, the largest secure email service globally, and has since expanded to include Proton VPN, Proton Calendar, Proton Drive, and Proton Pass. These tools empower individuals and organizations to take control of their personal data, break away from Big Tech’s invasive practices, and defeat censorship. Our work impacts hundreds of millions of lives, from activists on the front lines defending freedom to leaders in governments protecting sensitive information. In some cases, Proton’s services have even been instrumental in saving lives by enabling secure and private communications in high-risk situations.

Proton today supports over 100 million user accounts with a growing team of over 500 people from over 50 different countries, from the world's top companies and universities. We value intelligence, learning potential, and ambition in our hiring process. Adaptability is key as we navigate uncharted territories and redefine how business is conducted online. We believe smaller teams of exceptional talent will always prevail over larger teams with lower talent density. Proton has become profitable and reached scale without relying upon VC funding, largely due to superior talent that allows us to do things faster, more creatively, and more efficiently.

We have a global mindset and big ambitions but remain a start-up at heart. We value empowerment and flexibility and keep our structure flat to keep moving fast and avoid unnecessary politics. Tired of blending into the crowd? Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our social media pages to learn more about us: Twitter, Reddit, Instagram.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Business Development Manager focused on building strategic partnerships and generating high-quality pipeline for Proton’s B2B business. This is a key role focused on identifying and unlocking new business opportunities — not closing deals.

You will work on developing relationships with key organisations, partners, and networks — particularly within Switzerland — to position Proton within strategic ecosystems and create long-term pipeline opportunities.

This role requires a strong talent to network, a “hunter” mindset for opportunity creation, and the ability to navigate complex organisations to open doors for commercial engagement.

What You’ll Do

Pipeline Creation & Strategic Opportunity Development

- Identify and develop new strategic opportunities across target segments

- Build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities for the sales team

- Focus on long-term opportunity creation rather than short-term deal closing

Strategic Partnerships

- Identify, engage, and develop partnerships with corporates, industry bodies, service providers, ecosystem partners (including co-selling opportunities)

Market Development (Switzerland Focus)

- Leverage your existing network within Swiss corporates and organisations

- Expand Proton’s presence within local business ecosystems

- Identify high-value entry points into target companies

Relationship Building

- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders (IT, security, leadership)

- Act as a trusted advisor and entry point into organisations

- Navigate complex organisational structures to identify opportunities

Sales Opportunity Discovery and Closing

- Identify and qualify opportunities

- Provide clear context on use case, stakeholders, potential deal scope

-Negotiate and close deals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Sales leadership to align on target segments

- Provide feedback on market opportunities and ICP evolution

- Share insights from partnerships and market interactions

What We’re Looking For

Experience

- 3–7 years in Business Development, Partnerships, or Strategic Sales roles

- Experience in B2B SaaS or technology environments

- Proven track record in building partnerships and generating pipeline

Network

- Strong existing network within Swiss companies and/or business ecosystem (highly preferred)

- Appetite to develop and grow a network of Swiss and DACH companies

Skills

- Strong relationship-building and networking capabilities

- Ability to identify and develop strategic opportunities

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

- Comfortable operating without a structured playbook

Languages

- Fluent in English (required)

- Business-level proficiency in BOTH French and German (required)

Mindset

- Hunter mindset focused on opportunity creation

- Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts

- Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable operating in ambiguity

- Long-term relationship builder

- Proton is an office-first company. We expect you to spend most of your time in the office, and while we do offer some flexibility to work from home, we believe in-person collaboration helps us build the best products.

• What we offer

  • Technology: We provide all the devices and software you need to excel in your role, ensuring you have the best tools at your disposal to achieve your goals.
  • Food: Lunch and snacks are provided by Proton every day at our offices.
  • Transport: We will always support our employees with transport costs through subsidizing public transport, bike allowances, or parking spaces based on your office location.
  • Stock Options: At Proton, we are all owners of the company and you get stock options when you join us.
  • Flexible Working: You can define your own working hours as long as it works with team meetings.
  • Learning and Development: We are committed to your professional growth. Proton offers various learning opportunities, including training programs, conferences and events, and continual learning.
  • Employee Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance plans, competitive retirement savings options, generous vacation and leave policies, and wellness programs.
  • Work that Matters: Proton is a community-first organization, started with the support of a crowdfunding campaign and built with community input. To this day, Proton’s only source of revenue is user subscriptions. Over 100 million people trust and support Proton, and we put our users and community first in everything we do. Read more about our impact here.

Check our social media to learn more about Proton:

LinkedIn ,Reddit ,X, YouTube

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.
